chunks: The idolaters have no right to visit the mosques of God while bearing testimony to their disbelief. Meaningless will be their acts, and in Hell they will bide for ever,
ai.seo_question: Why are polytheists considered unfit to worship in the mosques of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (9:28) is often linked to the specific context of the Prophet's time, where polytheists were considered ritually impure (najis) and thus barred from the inner sanctums of mosques like the Kaaba. It underscores the theological principle that ritual purity in worship is contingent upon sincere monotheism, rendering the deeds of those who combine worship with idolatry void.
